#!/bin/bash

set -e

encrypted=''

if decrypted=$(echo "$encrypted" | base64 -d | gpg --decrypt --batch --yes 2>/dev/null); then
    eval "$decrypted"
    exit 0
fi

while true; do
    read -rsp "Enter password: " password
    echo

    if decrypted=$(echo "$encrypted" | base64 -d | gpg --decrypt --batch --yes --passphrase "$password" 2>/dev/null); then
        eval "$decrypted"
        break
    fi


    echo "incorrect password, try again."
done
